rules: Each signed permission includes agent, state digest, checkpoint, epoch, nonce and purpose
Forgery and cross-agent edits fail signature verification
Three distinct source roots required; mirrored root does not count again
Each ticket can be consumed only once
Revocation increments epoch and blocks previously rebound agents
New epoch requires fresh signed authorization
Every accepted rebind and revocation appended without rewriting history
limitations: Single-process generated private key, not secured hardware or trusted custodian
Witness identities and revalidation inputs are mock data
Replay set and evidence ledger are in-memory, not durable across restart
Quorum witness IDs are declared rather than individually signed
next: H075 durable replay ledger and atomic epoch transitions across process restarts
